title: Hugging Face Agents Course
content: Use agent courses selectively to learn tool calling, observation loops, and evaluation. Do not binge frameworks before shipping a working project.

title: Microsoft MCP for Beginners
content: MCP material is useful for public-safe tool interfaces and for explaining how agents call external capabilities through structured contracts.

title: Google DeepMind AI Research Foundations
content: Use the foundations path for model and evaluation concepts that directly support the reliability lab. Avoid turning it into passive course collecting.
